name: background-beams-with-collision
blurb: Animated beams fall from top, explode on collision with ground.
description: Container with gradient background that animates falling beams. Detects collision with a bottom surface and triggers explosion particles on impact using motion/react. Supports light and dark themes.
use_when: Interactive hero section or container needing constant animated particle effects with collision feedback.
avoid_when: Performance-critical pages with many instances, or sites requiring prefers-reduced-motion support.
a11y: Purely decorative background; children elements must handle their own accessibility.
